Value.description: A raw value: true/false; an integer (an int, a fixed's underlying integer, a float's bit pattern), as a decimal string outside ±2^53; a variant name; a table's or list's elements; or a record's fields.

chain.description:
How the original gets there: the producer's state chain, relative to
the workspace (for psx, `notes/states/<name>.json`).

compare.description:
The glossary quantities compared, each with its tolerance in raw
units (0: exactly; bool and enum quantities only exactly).

feature.description: The feature whose integration test it is.

idle.description:
The determinism check's idle fields, added before the chain's last
run (60 when left out).

moment.description: The moment it starts at, in game terms.

parameters.description: How the port gets there: what its launcher builds the world from.
